de: War of the Austrian Succession: The Battle of Toulon causes several Royal Navy captains to be court-martialed, and the Articles of War to be amended.

t: 一场风暴潮淹没了弗里斯兰海岸,淹死了15000人.
te: A storm surge floods the Frisian coast, drowning 15,000 people.
dz: 圣彼得洪水:一场风暴潮淹没了弗里斯兰海岸,淹死了15000人.
de: St. Peter's Flood: A storm surge floods the Frisian coast, drowning 15,000 people.

t: 托斯卡纳大公费迪南多二世·德·美第奇(Ferdinando II de' Medici)作为奉…
te: Ferdinando II de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany, the dedicatee, receives the first printed copy of Galileo's Dialogue C…
dz: 托斯卡纳大公费迪南多二世·德·美第奇(Ferdinando II de' Medici)作为奉献者,获得"伽利略关于两个世界酋长系统的对话"的第一份印刷本.
de: Ferdinando II de' Medici, Grand Duke of Tuscany, the dedicatee, receives the first printed copy of Galileo's Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems.

t: 法国国王查理八世进入那不勒斯要求该市的王位.
te: King Charles VIII of France enters Naples to claim the city's throne.
dz: 法国国王查理八世进入那不勒斯要求该市的王位.
de: King Charles VIII of France enters Naples to claim the city's throne.

t: 罗伯特二世成为苏格兰国王,开始斯图尔特王朝.
te: Robert II becomes King of Scotland, beginning the Stuart dynasty.
dz: 罗伯特二世成为苏格兰国王,开始斯图尔特王朝.
de: Robert II becomes King of Scotland, beginning the Stuart dynasty.

t: 皮克廷战役由马约卡的斐迪南与海诺特的玛蒂尔达的部队相接而来,最终为斐迪南取胜.
te: The Battle of Picotin, between Ferdinand of Majorca and the forces of Matilda of Hainaut, ends in victory for Ferdinand.
dz: 皮克廷战役由马约卡的斐迪南与海诺特的玛蒂尔达的部队相接而来,最终为斐迪南取胜.
de: The Battle of Picotin, between Ferdinand of Majorca and the forces of Matilda of Hainaut, ends in victory for Ferdinand.

t: 方济会会士吉罗拉莫·马斯奇被选为教皇,选择了尼古拉斯四世的名字.
te: The Franciscan Girolamo Maschi is elected pope, choosing the name Nicholas IV.
dz: 方济会会士吉罗拉莫·马斯奇被选为教皇,选择了尼古拉斯四世的名字.
de: The Franciscan Girolamo Maschi is elected pope, choosing the name Nicholas IV.

t: 在 2 月 14 日至 20 日的四旬斋会议期间收到一封要求他退位的信后，教皇格列高利七世将神…
te: Having received a letter during the Lenten synod of 14–20 February demanding that he abdicate, Pope Gregory VII excommu…
dz: 在 2 月 14 日至 20 日的四旬斋会议期间收到一封要求他退位的信后，教皇格列高利七世将神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利四世逐出教会。
de: Having received a letter during the Lenten synod of 14–20 February demanding that he abdicate, Pope Gregory VII excommunicates Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 教宗福莫苏斯加冕为卡林西亚的阿努尔夫为罗马皇帝. 阿努尔夫不久后中风,从意大利撤退.
te: Pope Formosus crowns Arnulf of Carinthia as Emperor in Rome. Arnulf suffers a stroke soon after and retreats from Italy.
dz: 教宗福莫苏斯加冕为卡林西亚的阿努尔夫为罗马皇帝. 阿努尔夫不久后中风,从意大利撤退.
de: Pope Formosus crowns Arnulf of Carinthia as Emperor in Rome. Arnulf suffers a stroke soon after and retreats from Italy.
